name: ux-research-pipeline
description: An AI research assistant for qualitative in-depth interviews. 13 stages from a stakeholder brief to a finished report, presented through a concierge-style chat: you talk to the agent, it decides which step to run.
author: shipaleks
v2_roadmap: desk-research-index — RAG over an archive of past transcripts and reports
live-cohost — a co-pilot during the interview itself
edits-categorizer — auto-diff and categorization of the researcher's edits
regression-eval — a golden set + prompt regression after the first projects
